title: Equality characterizes coordinate unateness
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f\colon\{\pm1\}^n\to\{\pm1\}$ be a Boolean function, and let $i$ be a coordinate. The absolute value of the singleton Fourier coefficient in coordinate $i$ equals the influence of $f$ in that coordinate if and only if $f$ is monotone or antimonotone in coordinate $i$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function from the $n$-dimensional sign cube to signs
